Virgil Voltspun!

Workaholic Webbed Wonder

Pronouns He/him, it/its
Nom de Plume Web-Surfer
Species Human mutate
Age Adult
Occupation Vigilante, freelance photographer, full-time student
Birthplace Disco, Wisconsin, URL
Nicknames & Titles Vee, Vivi, Virge, Virgin, Neuro-Die-a-Virgin, Publius, Webby, Webs, Web-Head, Webster, Spider…
Song(s) Reminds Me…, Eyeless, Untitled 03, Into the Cosmos (the Void of Space), Be Someone Forever, Down in it

Okay. Let's take this from the top, one last time.
So, go on then. Call him what you'd like.

Miserable. Wretched. Hah, even a downer, if you will. It's not gonna change shit in the long run; that's if there'll even be a long run to look forward to in the first place.

'Course, when Virgil Vesper Voltspun first got mutated thanks to that stupid ass spider biting him in the middle of his literal suicide attempt a while back, he thought — heh, don't make fun of him — his newfound superhuman abilities were the coolest thing in the whole fucking world. Y'know, 'cause he was twelve and didn't know what he was getting into.

The fuck's a cooler thing to a twelve-year-old than getting superpowers?

Becoming a vigilante, that's right.
Virgil's been a downright loser since he was a kid. People literally gave him fucking wedgies. Of course he's gonna embrace the possibility of being one of the cool vigilantes and supers on TV without thinking twice! It's a miracle he even thought of obscuring his identity with this whole 'Web-Surfer' personality!

The point is that, well… Virgil's tired. There is no point to any of this.
Everyone wants to make the world a better place, but every problem humanity faces is too deeply rooted in its way of life. Politicians will tell you the quality of life's improved since the start of the third millennium, but it's the same as it ever was with some damn flowers, really.
Supers and vigilantes don't do shit beyond remind any "criminal scum" of the status quo. Oh, and capitalize off it, of course. Glorified cops and criminals with fandoms and superpowers is all the super scene is, was, and ever will be. Something to be gawked at through a screen and not much else; faceless and temporary.
If we're lucky, it'll all return to the dust whence it came.

Like everything, Virgil feels… paralyzed. Equally unchanged as the crime-ridden shithole that is Nouvelle-Yorke, but also unrecognizable.
He's trapped in a loop of guilt and moral obligations to this city. He can't do much beyond protecting it the only way he knows how, but he knows full-well it's not doing shit but delaying the inevitable.

There's no one to turn to and nowhere to go. If he doesn't want to sit idly, the only thing he can do in the face of certain doom is punch. Punch until the world is indiscernible from your fist and your screams are indistinguishable from your wishes because your life's been consumed by a fucking lie and your morals will crumble under the weight of rage like your enemy's skull.

He's everything and nothing and the world's never gonna change for the better until each and every human is fucking dead and gone. With how everything's going, he's about one more case of cop bribery, corruption, or bigotry away from just outright killing his opponents… or himself.

Hm. We're all fucked.

Attributes

Abilities

  • "Stick-'Em Powers"
    Setae (bristles) on Virgil's hands and feet enable him to 'stick' onto solid surfaces. These are very, VERY sticky to make up for Virgil not being spider-sized. His palms and soles look unnaturally hairy at times.
  • Organic webbing
    Ultra durable and sturdy webbing is produced in Virgil's body, which emerges through the spinnerets in his wrists. Very limited and often causes bleeding from the spigots due to overuse.
  • Enhanced strength, senses, durability, reflexes, endurance, agility, and equilibrium
  • Above average processing speed
  • "Spider-Sense"
    It's a bit complicated, but, in short, he can sense vibrations, chemicals, electricity (to some extent), and air currents from anything via tactile hairs all over his body, like Daredevil's hearing, so to speak. If something seems dangerous in his opinion, the epicenter of this sense on the back of his nape triggers his brain to activate fight or flight. All of this happens very, very fast, so people speculate Web-Surfer has precognition, which is untrue.
    He can also kind of tell/guess what a person is feeling or thinking since the sense can pick up biochemical reactions, sort of like pheromones (although humans probably don't have those). He's memorized a few specific substances and their correlated emotions (mostly fear and danger), but Virgil's notoriously bad with feelings, empathy, and people… so this 'diet mind reading' is kind of useless.
  • Highly accelerated metabolism
  • Healing factor
    Not as good as Deadpool's or Wolverine's, but nothing to sneeze at either.
  • Chemical, drug, poison, disease, and alcohol resistance
    Not totally immune, but requires a higher dosage of most chemicals to feel any sort of effects. Even then, said effects most likely won't last long.
  • Spider-like behavior
    Has natural spidery instincts, leans into them more when mental health is in the shitter and/or adhering to social standards isn't a big priority. Most prominent of these include: reclusiveness, aggression, defensiveness, skittishness, and ballooning. However, Virgil displayed these behaviors before his mutation (though, the ballooning's new). The bite just exacerbated them.
  • Chelicerae
    Usually folded on the roof of his mouth.
  • Venom
    Not the symbiote.
    Virgil's chelicerae can administer a weak neurotoxin. Symptoms include: muscle spasms, cramping, paralysis, numbness, tremors, and feelings of impending doom.
  • "Knockback"
    You ever play Ultrakill?
    Virgil is able to counter any projectile with at least double of its oncoming kinetic force to send it back whence it came regardless of weight or size. Three problems though: 1) he needs to actually be able to hit the projectile hard (light taps don't count, plus, the projectile must have a solid surface, no liquids nor gasses), 2) he must react fast enough to deflect it (for example: he could, hypothetically, punch a bullet, but it'd be highly risky due to the sheer speed of one), and 3) deflecting objects larger than he can carry is extremely painful and could result in injuries or death.

Equipment

  • Wrist-mounted web-shooters + web-fluid
    This world is an advanced one that is so, so eager to invade your privacy. Technology developed to track people through a wide variety of biological signatures are not uncommon. Thus, Virgil devised a synthetic, better variant of his webbing. Also because the feeling of webs coming out of your arms is disgusting.
  • Drones
    Primarily for pictures and not exactly useful for most of his vigilante work. Used to photograph, spy on or track adversaries, and survey areas.
    Shaped like metallic bugs with massive lenses for faces.
  • Web-wings
    Remember ballooning? Yeah… This is how he does that.
  • Mask
    Webby's got electronics in his mask to assist with his work, Tony Stark style, but make it broke. No AI though, too expensive to replace.
  • "Tactical Paws"
    Not just for decoration. His suit has dubious access to police resources and these pads can replicate fingerprints (or animal paw prints to cover up his tracks), provide small bursts of electricity, and… squeak when pressed on occasion. To calm people (himself) down when stressed. Of course.
  • Laptop A military-grade laptop that Harvey Osborne didn't want anymore. It has nerdy stickers on the back. He never uses it for his vigilante work.
  • Cyberdecks
    Liz Allan likes DIY and crafting, so Virgil decided to try it by building computers. These are mainly for his vigilantism, but he also builds miscellaneous projects and even replaced cell phones with these because his keep breaking. Nearly all of them look like hunks of shit.

Notes

  • Kind of tall (for a trans guy) because he wasn't on testosterone when he first mutated and spider sexual dimorphism resulted in a growth spurt. ~5'10/177.8 cm.
  • On that note, Virgil also has PCOS, which is why he's not really that tall. This is also partially why he's so hairy.
  • No, he doesn't have urticating hairs.
  • Web-Surfer's mask has hammerspace, like Spider-Punk's.
  • Virgil is still pretty chubby even after becoming a super because he doesn't really train or work out beyond his exploits as Web-Surfer. He just relies on his abilities and it works for him. He has muscular arms and legs, at least.
  • Scars can be drawn however. They should just look roughly the same in roughly the same spots.
  • Virgil is transmasc. He doesn't start officially transitioning (HRT, top surgery, phalloplasty) and appearing more masculine until adulthood.
  • Suffers from resting bitch face like none before him. Has a deadpan or some other stoic expression more often than not because he will never overcome the curse of flat affect. Nearly always looks and sounds deadly serious.
  • His voice is also deep and fairly 'robotic'/monotone. He's working on trying to improve this, and sounds remarkably less robotic than when he was little, but not quite perfect at sounding personable.
  • Virgil has a flat chest as Web-Surfer due to a mix of dubious binding methods and image inducers before he caved and got top surgery. His tits were pretty big before they were removed.

Trivia

  • Virgil's favorite food is Chicago-style meat-lovers' pizza. He does not enjoy chunky tomato sauce though.
  • Virgil was bitten by a frantic, abnormally large Heteroscodra maculata.
  • Virgil owns two female frogs named Miette and Pippins.
  • Did not name himself 'Web-Surfer.' Someone thought a joke he made was his alias and spread it. Virgil could only salvage the hyphen.
  • Has no clue how his mutation works. He was mutated due to a spider bite, but spiders don't parry attacks nor have a healing factor. Forever confused by this.
  • Curls up in his bed nest when sad or stressed. But he's sad/stressed every day, so he partakes in this every night.
  • He automatically purrs when contented, excited, or horny. Finds this extremely embarrassing and will flee any social interaction the second this starts.
  • Physically cannot sit through scenes he deems "socially embarrassing" in media because he cringes too hard. Either blocks it out or skips it entirely.
  • Virgil's enhanced senses and Spider-Sense make it extremely difficult to sneak up on/surprise him, which is great, because he hates surprises. However, it's not impossible to do so.
  • Uses video game moves in fights. Did this when he was starting out due to a lack of combat training, but got too used to it even after learning to fight. You ever see someone perform a twenty-hit aerial combo in real life? That's Virgil's style.
  • Virgil isn't a virgin.
  • Web-Surfer doesn't like surfing.
  • Only celebrates holidays because Liz loves celebrating with him. Doesn't acknowledge them otherwise.
  • Allergic to peppermint. Detests citrus.
  • Managed to get gender-affirming surgery because he nagged Doom and said he'll go to Mister Fantastic if she doesn't perform it.
